title: Acoustic representations of different dimensions of the gendered self
why_promising: Primary semi-spontaneous German speech from 53 speakers (52 analyzed); recordings were manually segmented and annotated in Praat at picture, carrier-word, and target-sound levels, and the article states that the dataset, Praat scripts, and R code are available in an OSF repository.
